golden_baseline_location: testdata/legacy/manifests/<ns>.json (targets oracle.OW_BILLING.INVOICE_HEADER rows=18750, INVOICE_LINE rows=150000 checksum=88a66751f0b08b476b492105a2efc537 at NS=demo)

acceptance_checks.description: invoices collection holds exactly the manifest INVOICE_HEADER row count (18750 at NS=demo).
every non-orphaned INVOICE_LINE row is embedded in its header document; embedded line total equals manifest line count minus quarantined orphans (149963 at NS=demo).
order-independent md5 checksum recomputed from embedded lines plus quarantined orphans matches the manifest INVOICE_LINE checksum (every source line accounted for exactly once).
orphaned lines (no matching header) are quarantined with attribution and enumerated; never silently dropped and never embedded in a fabricated header.

encoding_policy.input_encoding: UTF-8 as stored in Oracle VARCHAR2 (AL32UTF8)
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: string fields carried byte-for-byte; numeric amounts preserved exactly (no float rounding of cents)
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: records that do not decode as UTF-8 are quarantined with attribution

malformed_record_policy.details: NULL source columns are omitted fields; a NULL amount never fails open to 0. Lines referencing missing headers are quarantined, not dropped.

empty_input_semantics.details: a run against an empty/absent source namespace writes nothing and leaves prior target output untouched.

planted_anomalies.description: 37 orphaned INVOICE_LINE rows referencing ghost invoice ids (manifest kind=orphaned_rows)
